Content.SourceString: 远方，散文诗人，咖啡鉴赏师，终生背包客，修行家，爱情学者，流浪汉，口琴艺人，业余导师，实习异象猎人，电话接线员。
Content.LocalizedString: Faraway: Prose poet, coffee connoisseur, lifelong backpacker, spiritual practitioner, scholar of love, vagabond, harmonica artist, amateur mentor, apprentice anomaly hunter, telephone operator.

OptionText.LocalizedString: That's a lot of people with us today!
Could you please not do that?

Content.SourceString: 怎么有一个格格不入……
Content.LocalizedString: One of these is not like the others…

Content.SourceString: 今天有这么多人？
Content.LocalizedString: That's a lot of people with us today!

Content.SourceString: 别这样好吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Could you please not do that?

Content.SourceString: 只是一个身份罢了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just one of my many identities, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 事实上，这些都是我。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, all of these titles are mine.

Content.SourceString: 好的。
Content.LocalizedString: I see.

Content.SourceString: 我的故事，来自一个潮湿的，弥漫着丁香花香气的雨夜。
Content.LocalizedString: My story begins on a damp, rainy night, perfumed with the scent of lilacs.

Content.SourceString: 贫瘠的文字，不，一切语言都无法描述那个美妙的夜晚。
Content.LocalizedString: Mere words… no, all language fails to capture the wonder of that night.

OptionText.LocalizedString: What a strange way of speaking.
Do you really have to talk like that?

Content.SourceString: 你的说话方式有点奇怪。
Content.LocalizedString: Your way of speaking is a bit unusual.

Content.SourceString: 你一定要这么说话吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you really have to talk like that?

Content.SourceString: 这就是散文诗人吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So this is what a Prose Poet is like?

Content.SourceString: 那是一通神秘来电，就像她一样，神秘的丁香女子。
Content.LocalizedString: It was a mysterious call, just like her—the enigmatic lady. She was like the Lilac…

Content.SourceString: 哦，我的紫丁香，我的阿芙洛狄忒！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, my Lilac, my Aphrodite!

Content.SourceString: 哦，好吧，看来我的诗歌依旧不受欢迎。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I see. It seems my poetry still isn't well-received.

Content.SourceString: 唉，世俗的厌倦，艺术仍无立足之地。
Content.LocalizedString: Alas, the weariness of the mundane world—art still has no place to stand.

Content.SourceString: 好吧好吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Fine, fine.

Content.SourceString: 一个月前，不，准确说是三十二天前，我接到了一个电话。
Content.LocalizedString: A month ago—no, to be precise, thirty-two days ago—I received a phone call.

Content.SourceString: 当时六家杂志社都拒绝了我的投稿，就在我心灰意冷的时候，角落里的电话响了。
Content.LocalizedString: Six magazine publishers had rejected my submissions, and just when I was at my lowest, the phone in the corner rang.

Content.SourceString: 那是旧时代的产物，褪色的童年记忆里，它早已蒙上了尘埃。
Content.LocalizedString: It was a relic from a bygone era, gathering dust in the faded memories of childhood.

Content.SourceString: 咳咳。
Content.LocalizedString: Ahem.

Content.SourceString: 我以为是什么老牌出版社，想也没想就接起来，对面是一个很好听的女声。
Content.LocalizedString: I thought it might be some established publishing house, so I answered without a second thought—and was greeted by a lovely female voice.

Content.SourceString: 是打错了电话，但是就是这样的巧合，她居然也懂诗歌。
Content.LocalizedString: It was a wrong number, but by some strange coincidence, she actually appreciated poetry too.

Content.SourceString: 现在，我每天的事情就是等待她的来电，和她分享我的新作。
Content.LocalizedString: These days, all I do is wait for her calls so I can share my latest works with her.

Content.SourceString: 我沉入爱河了，是的，我沉入了爱河。
Content.LocalizedString: I've fallen in love, yes, I've fallen in love.

OptionText.LocalizedString: The phone bills must be expensive, right?

Content.SourceString: 你们每天都通话？
Content.LocalizedString: You two talk on the phone every day?

Content.SourceString: 每天打电话花费一定很贵吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Daily phone calls must cost quite a bit, I imagine.

Content.SourceString: 我申请跳过爱情故事。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd like to formally request we skip your love story arc.

Content.SourceString: 当然，就算那台老古董电话线断了，我们的爱情却连接了起来。
Content.LocalizedString: Absolutely. Even if that antique phone's line got disconnected, our love made a connection.

Content.SourceString: 话费？那台老古董的电话线早都断了。
Content.LocalizedString: Phone bills? The line on that old antique phone has been disconnected for ages.

Content.SourceString: 我这可悲的爱情就像断掉的电话线一样摇摇欲坠，我只是想和人分享。
Content.LocalizedString: My pitiful love hangs by a thread like that disconnected phone line, I just wanted to share it with someone.

Content.SourceString: 等一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Wait.

Content.SourceString: 你是说一台断了线的没电的通讯设备每晚都会自己响起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So you're saying a disconnected, unpowered communication device rings by itself every night?

Content.SourceString: 没错。
Content.LocalizedString: That's right.

Content.SourceString: 太浪漫了，我神秘的爱人。
Content.LocalizedString: So romantic, my mysterious lover.

Content.SourceString: 虽然她还不知晓我的心意，也许是我的表达过于含蓄，爱情使我胆怯。
Content.LocalizedString: Although she still doesn't know my true feelings—perhaps my expressions are too subtle—love makes me timid.

Content.SourceString: 但它又让我强大，所以我来了，我要证明我的决心。
Content.LocalizedString: But love also makes me strong, that's why I'm here—to prove my determination.

Content.SourceString: 为此我又写了一首诗。
Content.LocalizedString: For this occasion, I've written another poem.

Content.SourceString: 什么诗？
Content.LocalizedString: What poem?

Content.SourceString: 你们稿费给的多吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you pay well for poem submissions?

Content.SourceString: 如果想要刊登我的诗，请你们编辑联系我，尊重版权。
Content.LocalizedString: If you want to publish my poem, please have your editor contact me directly—respect copyright.

Content.SourceString: 紫丁香，阿芙洛狄忒，<Red>电话接线员。</>
Content.LocalizedString: Lilac, Aphrodite, <Red>Telephone Operator.</>

Content.SourceString: 电话接线员？
Content.LocalizedString: Telephone operator?

Content.SourceString: 我的故事，来自一台断线的废弃电话机。
Content.LocalizedString: My story came from a disconnected, abandoned telephone.

Content.SourceString: <Red>三十二天前</>，终于有人接听了<Red>我的来电。</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Red>Thirty-two days ago</>, someone finally answered <Red>my call.</>

Content.SourceString: 我喜欢他的诗。
Content.LocalizedString: I like his poetry.

Content.SourceString: 如果不止是在电话里听见……
Content.LocalizedString: If only I could do more than just hear him through the phone…

Content.SourceString: 你要做什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What are you going to do?

Content.SourceString: <Red>想见面。</>

Content.SourceString: 我们在一起了，就像诗歌中一样幸福。
Content.LocalizedString: We're together now, as blissful as in poetry.
